Hi Elena —

Thanks for the productive demo yesterday. Procurement is ready to move Silverpine to vendor activation, but we need a handful of mandated artifacts before we can issue a PO and route invoices:

- Fully executed DPA (Redwood template or counter-signed accepted)
- SOC 2 Type II report (or a secure link + access expiration)
- Current subprocessor roster (CSV preferred)
- Vendor billing remit instructions and tax details (for PO and AP)

Can you confirm whether Silverpine can: 1) e-sign the DPA via DocuSign, 2) provide a secure SOC 2 link we can download, and 3) attach the subprocessor CSV? Our target is to have the PO issued by end of next week (5/17).

Cc'ing Lauren from Legal to call out any contractual questions. If you prefer, we can also accept a scanned signed DPA PDF attached to an email.

1) DPA: We can e-sign via DocuSign. I'll start the envelope today and send you the link when it's ready.
2) SOC 2: Here's a secure link to our 2028 Type II report (downloadable): https://storage.silverpine.ai/reports/SOC2_Type2_2028.pdf
   - Access expires 30 days from issue. If you need a longer window we can arrange a temporary viewer account.
3) Subprocessors: attaching our current roster as CSV. It includes provider name, purpose, country, and data handling notes.
4) Billing: Silverpine accepts PO and works with standard net-30 terms. Remit instructions in billing@silverpine.ai — I asked Billing to confirm tax ID and W-9.

I expect the signed DPA link within 24 hours. Let me know if Redwood has any deviations to our standard DPA we should expect.

Appreciate the quick response and the CSV. A couple of clarifications from Procurement / AP so we can avoid back-and-forth once the PO is ready:

- PO header info: Redwood needs the legal entity name exactly as it appears on your W-9, plus remittance address and VAT/GST ID if applicable.
- Invoice acceptance: Please confirm whether invoices should be sent to billing@silverpine.ai (PDF) or uploaded to your portal.
- Tax forms: Billing, if you can attach the W-9 or equivalent, that will speed PO creation.
- DPA: we'll sign the DocuSign envelope as soon as it's received. If there are any SOW-specific data controls we should account for in the DPA (regional data residency, dedicated keying), flag those now so Legal and I can review.

Our timeline: target PO issuance 2028-05-17, contingent on executed DPA + W-9 + subprocessor roster. If any of those slip, let me know and we'll adjust.
